scope: Supplied testament originals, including nested and linked folders; source availability, not a claim of complete transcription

john-lanark-1650.method: Astra xhigh visual inspection of both PDF pages, the opening crop and the separate image 66; recursive supplied-file inventory
john-lanark-1650.opening: Image 65 contains the opening, inventory and first debts. The PNG is a 1194 by 1032 pixel crop of that entry, not a separate missing page.
john-lanark-1650.continuation: John's debts continue at the top of image 66, followed by totals and confirmation. The top of image 66 is not a preceding testament.
john-lanark-1650.reading_status: Opening identity, sister clause, document type and record continuity visually checked; a full diplomatic transcription of the opening and accounts remains unfinished.

john-1577.boundary: John's continuation occupies the upper block of image 277, before another testament. The purchased PDF also supplies an associated Hutcheson fragment as a supplementary Image 276 view; keep it as contextual research material without merging its distinct estate text into John's transcription.

observations: PDF pages 1 and 3 both carry Image 276, CC8/8/5, the Johne Glasgw download title and the same generation timestamp. Page 2 carries Image 277.
Page 1 shows the complete leaf numbered 276. Page 3 shows an irregular-edged horizontal strip marked 396A beside an older struck-through number.
No repeated underlying John lines establish a raised/lowered-flap pair, and the exact physical attachment cannot be demonstrated from the supplied photographs.
The rubric identifies the confirmation of Andro Hutchesoun: identification of the separate testament is strong, but exact surname spelling remains provisional.
Bairnis and a Johne name are visible. Their full clauses, associated identities, locality and date require closer transcription.
associated_fragment.interpretation: A supplementary view was delivered with image 276. This is a real documentary association, not evidence of accidental inclusion; it does not by itself establish a genealogical relationship.
associated_fragment.family_lead: The supplied human reading hochaine, possibly a phonetic Hutchin form, makes the Hutcheson fragment relevant to Margaret and the family network. Neither surname normalization nor a specific relationship to Andro is established.
next_steps: Transcribe the complete fragment, particularly the children and Johne clauses, without borrowing expected names from the Glasgow family.
Compare its people, places, executors and debts with John Glasgow's testament.
Ask NRS or ScotlandsPeople what the strip marked 396A represents and why it is associated with image 276; the exact attachment/export rationale is not established by these views.

context_source.title: Rob Mildren, Digitisation of Wills and Testaments by SCAN
context_source.supports: The digitisation project captured complete volumes in sequence and also handled loose-leaf material. It does not explain this specific fragment or establish a family connection.
